{{nihongo|'''Inazume Shrine'''|稲爪神社}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} enshrined in Ōkura Honmachi, {{ill|Akashi, Hyōgo|Q26406|qid=Q26406}}, {{ill|Hyōgo Prefecture|Q130290|qid=Q130290}}. Its former rank under the {{ill|Q712534|lt=Modern shrine ranking system}} was gōsha. It is one of the shrines identified with Iwatsuhime Shrine in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}. {{nihongo|'''Inazume Shrine'''|稲爪神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Harima Province]].

== Origin ==
In the time of {{ill|Empress Suiko|Q298057|qid=Q298057}}, iron men from {{ill|Samhan|Q1376093|qid=Q1376093}} invaded with 8,000 followers. Ochi Masami of {{ill|Iyo Province|cs|Provincie Ijo|de|Provinz Iyo|es|Provincia de Iyo|fa|ولایت ایو|fi|Iyon provinssi|fr|Province d'Iyo|gl|Provincia de Iyo|id|Provinsi Iyo|it|Iyo (provincia)|ja|伊予国|ko|이요국|lt|Ijo žemė|min|Provinsi Iyo|nl|Iyo (provincie)|pt|Província de Iyo|ru|Иё (провинция)|sh|Iyo (provincija)|simple|Iyo Province|sk|Ijo (provincia)|sr|Провинција Ијо|tr|Iyo (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Ійо|zh|伊予國|zh_min_nan|Iyo-kok|qid=Q907829}}, ordered to subdue them, prayed to Ōyamazumi deity of his home {{ill|Ōyamazumi Shrine|abstract|Q703904|fr|Ōyamazumi-jinja|ja|大山祇神社|ru|Оямадзуми-дзиндзя|zh|大山祇神社|qid=Q703904}}. When the iron men arrived at Akashi, Ōyamazumi appeared with lightning and told him to shoot the soles of their feet, their only weak point. Startled, the iron man was shot dead by Masami. In gratitude, Ochi Masami invited Ōyamazumi Shrine to the place where the deity appeared, and this is said to be the origin. In old times it was called Inazuma Daimyōjin; it is said "Inazuma" later shifted to "Inazume."

Also, a shrine built by Masami's son Takeo to enshrine Masami's spirit is said to be today's Ōkura Hachiman Shrine.

In {{ill|1578|Q6707|qid=Q6707}} ({{ill|Tenshō (Momoyama period)|Q1145058|qid=Q1145058}} 6), shrine buildings burned in military fire during {{ill|Justo Takayama|Q749873|qid=Q749873}}'s attack on Ōkuradani Castle, and the shrine moved north as a temporary shrine.

In {{ill|1637|Q6889|qid=Q6889}} ({{ill|Kan'ei|Q1192913|qid=Q1192913}} 14), shrine buildings were rebuilt and moved back to the original site. At the temporary-shrine location, {{ill|Matsudaira Mitsushige|Q11530371|qid=Q11530371|lt=Matsudaira Mitsushige}}, lord of {{ill|Akashi Domain|Q839406|qid=Q839406}}, invited {{ill|Kumano Gongen|Q11568925|qid=Q11568925|lt=Kumano Sansha Gongen}}, creating Kumano Kō Shrine.

In {{ill|1977|Q2481|qid=Q2481}} ({{ill|Shōwa era|Q327567|qid=Q327567}} 52), shrine buildings burned in an accidental fire, but were rebuilt in {{ill|1979|Q2484|qid=Q2484}} ({{ill|Shōwa era|Q327567|qid=Q327567}} 54).

== Sessha ==
; Inazumehama Ebisu Shrine
*Location: within Inazume Shrine precincts
*Deity: {{ill|Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto|lt=Kotoshironushi|Q8009611|qid=Q8009611|qid=Q8009611|lt=Kotoshironushi-no-Kami}}

; Ōkura Hachiman Shrine
*Location: Ōkura Hachiman-chō, Akashi
*Deity: Ochi Masami
*Founded by: Ochi Takeo
*Enshrines Ochi Masami, founder of Inazume Shrine. According to 'Akashi Meishō Kojidan,' it was formerly named Ochi Shrine, but in {{ill|1705|Q6830|qid=Q6830}} ({{ill|Hōei|Q1145262|qid=Q1145262}} 2), Akashi lord {{ill|Matsudaira Naotsune|Q11530528|qid=Q11530528}} renamed it "Hotade Hachiman" and renovated shrine buildings. In the {{ill|Edo period|Q184963|qid=Q184963}}, it was surrounded by forest, and artillery training of Akashi Domain was conducted in the eastern woods.

; Kumano Kō Shrine
*Location: Higashi-Hitomaru-chō, Akashi
*Deities: Kumano Sansha Gongen
